content.name: Potion of Healing
entries: You regain {@dice 2d4 + 2} hit points when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

content.name: Potion of Healing
entries: This potion is a magic item. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains {@dice 2d4 + 2} {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.
